title: Changes in and about a stream · one crossing at a time
finding: Changes in and about a stream may only be made in accordance with a change approval, the regulations, an authorization or an order, and each crossing rests on its own. On these answers the block makes changes in and about a stream that are not yet listed, so no crossing’s authority has been reviewed.

actions.description: List each crossing the block’s roads and harvesting make under Stream crossings, with its role and structure, and answer its questions there.
